builds.name: Reference: AP attack experiment
builds.goal: Reference for Kayle: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A level-scaling attack carry who grows from limited early reach into ranged wave attacks, using healing and invulnerability to preserve attack time. Use the recorded level/form and passive wave state. Compare AP/on-hit with crit at the actual attack range; R invulnerability preserves attack time but has a real cooldown. AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route.
testPlan: Kit question for Kayle: Use the recorded level/form and passive wave state. Compare AP/on-hit with crit at the actual attack range; R invulnerability preserves attack time but has a real cooldown.

Start with the early core (Nashor, then Rageblade) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.
